summary.intent: Ship GSD phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration) for CipherBox by wiring the v2.0 web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain across 33 execution plans and 3 gap-closure rounds, then run the full ship-phase pipeline (verify/secure/validate/simplify/E2E/CodeRabbit/PR) after logging deferrals as todos.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 reached verification PASSED 5/5 (commit 643f1b182) with the full web-e2e suite down to 2/205 failures (both approved deferrals); user then kicked off /ship-phase, which hit a CodeRabbit 150-file diff limit requiring per-directory splitting, and discovered the sdk-e2e gate has 89 skipped tests (7/10 fail when a probe un-skip is attempted), which was logged as a new deferred todo rather than fixed inline.

repo: mock-ipns-routing (delegated routing, :3001) keeps IPNS records in an in-memory Map — any container restart wipes it; records survive only via the API's synchronous ipns_records DB-cache write at publish time, so restarting it mid-dev-session can permanently orphan folders that were never DB-registered

createFolder previously omitted encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch on subfolder publish, so ipns_republish_schedule had zero rows — subfolder records would die at the 48h IPNS TTL in production; fixed via TEE enrollment in client.ts createFolder (68.1-16)

WriteChildRef is keyed by node UUID (childPub.id), never the ipnsName-based handle passed as moveItem's childId param — conflating the two silently orphans write-links (root cause of 68.1-31's move bug)

moveItem only ever re-linked the read-plane SealedChildRef and left the WriteChildRef orphaned in the source write-body — every file moved into a subfolder became permanently un-editable until 68.1-31 added unseal-under-source/reseal-under-dest re-homing
batch uploadFiles never inserted WriteChildRefs at all, so every web-uploaded file was un-savable from the start (fixed 68.1-29, commit 6fea17394)
SharedFolderTree stored a zeroed writeKey when cloning shared folder state, silently downgrading every write-permission share to read-only (fixed 68.1-29, commit 9725464dc)

Folder navigation/store had a D-02 kind-cache async race across three separate insertion sinks (SDK-event handler in folder.store.ts, handleSync in useFileBrowserActions.ts, resyncFolder in folder-helpers.ts) — fixing one sink alone masks the bug, all three must resolve kinds before inserting (68.1-33)

dfsFindFolder unconditionally re-resolved and overwrote every intermediate ancestor's folderTree entry on every call, even already-loaded write-capable ones, causing breadcrumb-up navigation to intermittently clobber state (68.1-26)

recovery.html (last touched Phase 24) hard-rejects any vault blob or metadata that isn't legacy v2 format, but the app has produced v3/node-v3 since Phase 62 — the recovery tool is fully incompatible with current data and needs its own port plan

apps/api's resolveRecord has a DB-canonical resolve floor that makes relay-replay attacks (rotation-durability SC-4) structurally unreachable in the current test harness — needs an API architecture decision or test redesign, not a client-side fix

shares table's plaintext item_name column was dropped entirely (not renamed) by migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover, making the REQ-4 itemName backfill dead code (shouldBackfill() permanently false) — redesign must ride the already-partially-shipped item_name_encrypted/ECIES pipeline, not revive plaintext storage (zero-knowledge rule)

mock-ipns-routing healthcheck used busybox `wget localhost`, which resolves to ::1, but the app binds IPv4-only — perpetual 'unhealthy' status was a healthcheck bug, not a service failure; fix is `127.0.0.1` in docker-compose.yml
Local e2e stack: API on :3000, delegated-routing mock on :3001 — the two are easy to conflate when health-probing

TEST_LOGIN_SECRET and DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL must be set on the API process env for local e2e test-login to succeed; mismatched/default secret gives a 401 'Invalid test login secret' with no other symptom

playwright web-e2e specs use describe.serial per file — a cascade-abort after the first failure in a file skips the rest, so a low failure count can mask far more actual coverage loss than it looks; use single-file re-runs to see the true frontier
CodeRabbit CLI review has a 150-file diff limit; a 179-file phase diff must be split into directory-scoped review passes

sdk-e2e suite has 89 tests skipped/quarantined against pre-v3-schema assumptions; un-skipping them without rework fails 7/10 — re-enabling needs a dedicated v3-alignment plan, not a mechanical un-skip

code.finding: moveItem re-homes the moved child's WriteChildRef (unseal under source writeKey, drop from source, reseal under dest writeKey, keyed by childPub.id at destEntry.generation, dest-before-source publish order preserved) — added in 68.1-31 to fix permanent un-editability after move

updateSharedSingleFile (68.1-32): new SDK method targeting a directly-shared file's own IPNS record, since the folder-based updateSharedFile path requires a seeded SharedFolderState/parent write-body that single-file shares never have

subscribeToSdk's folder:loaded/folder:updated handler does a hybrid projection: synchronous insert only when every child's kind is already cached, otherwise an async guarded resolveKinds-first path with a stale-sequence check — added in 68.1-33 to close the D-02 kind-cache race

handleSync is the actual reload-gating inserter that bypasses SDK events entirely (fires on FileBrowser mount) — must independently await resolveKinds before updateFolderChildren, since fixing only the store's SDK-event handler misses this path
getWriteBodyParams fail-opens to {} when writeKey is zero — this is the D-03 zero-key fallback that lets read-only-seeded folder state still publish (without a write-body) instead of throwing

workflow: Long-running background e2e/build agents in this harness reliably lose their wake-up signal after task completion, and their transcripts can get evicted entirely — mitigate with an independent disk-based watchdog (e.g. on `.last-run.json` mtime) plus prompt-based SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm, falling back to a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed_state context if evicted

Never use `git stash` in worktree-isolated executor agents — it operates on the shared refs/stash across all worktrees and can revert unrelated in-progress work; happened twice this session, both times self-caught and recovered via manual re-edit rather than stash pop

1Password git-commit signing can report commit_failed/timeout when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log -1` / `git log --oneline -1` before retrying, never blind-retry (which would create duplicate commits)

When a decision-coverage or similar gate parser reports 'could not parse', check exact bullet syntax requirements (e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**` needs the tag INSIDE the bold group, not after it) rather than assuming the gate itself is broken

Full test-suite tallies during a serial-cascade suite understate real breakage — a spec that dies in setup silently skips dozens of downstream assertions that would otherwise have run; always corroborate a 'small failure count' claim against a single-file re-run before trusting it as health signal

Session/quota limits can kill an agent mid-task after it already wrote a plan or made uncommitted changes to disk — always spot-check disk state (uncommitted diffs, partial plan files) before treating a limit-death as 'nothing happened', and recover by validating + committing the salvageable work inline

Live hands-on user testing (not just green e2e) surfaced 3 real bugs (cold-load subfolder nav, text-editor decryption-failed, move-then-edit write-capability) that the suite structurally could not reach due to serial-abort shadowing — green e2e does not mean every code path was exercised

friction: CodeRabbit CLI's 150-file diff cap forced an ad hoc per-directory review split for a 179-file phase diff

sdk-e2e gate surfaced 89 skipped tests with no prior visibility; probing by un-skipping one suite revealed 7/10 failures against v3 schema assumptions, meaning the 'passing' E2E gate was silently only covering ~11% of intended coverage
Two accidental `git stash` violations by worktree executors despite an explicit no-stash rule in their instructions
Repeated exit-gate/background-agent lost-wake incidents requiring manual disk inspection and resume nudges across multiple rounds
Two separate session/quota limit deaths mid-task (once mid-triage, once mid-planning) requiring inline recovery of uncommitted/undelivered work
Wrong cwd (a stray `cd docker` persisting) caused a false 'ROADMAP.md missing' scare that needed re-verification from repo root
mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck bug (localhost resolving to ::1 vs app's IPv4-only bind) caused a long, misleading 'unhealthy service' investigation that was actually a healthcheck config bug
Extracting live e2e suite progress required working around no usable `.last-run.json`, redirected stdout piped into an agent's background capture, and playwright wiping test-results/ every run
